motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Background and border transitions on enabled primary and rotation controls, background and color on loose tools; disclosure chevron transform.

motion.name: assembly
motion.purpose: Level-dependent smoothstep paths with arc and swirl. An upward clipping plane reveals the full-size packed sand from 28% to 95% progress, while the cap follows the fill height and profile radius.

motion.name: rotation-release
motion.purpose: Decaying sealed-bottle pointer-release inertia; stops below .00005.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No CSS transitions/animations or sealed release inertia; assembly immediately reaches sealed state. Direct loose input remains available, swirl preview shortens to 180ms and explicit restore is immediate.

motion.name: loose-push
motion.value: swept segment radius:28px; push=(1.7+min(1,length/14)*2.8)*falloff; linear damping:pow(.83,dt); no home spring
motion.purpose: Persistent grooves remain after motion settles, until explicit restore. Bitmap coordinates are independent of the bottle camera.

motion.name: loose-swirl
motion.value: radius:160px; omega=.080*pow(1-distance/160,.8); angular damping:pow(.86,dt); active linear damping:pow(.965,dt); preview:1100ms, reduced:180ms
motion.purpose: Hold to swirl at the pointer; selecting the tool previews a centered swirl. Angular motion decays after release.

motion.name: loose-restore
motion.value: per-grain delay:0–140ms; duration:820ms; cubic ease:1-pow(1-t,3); final settling:980ms
motion.purpose: Explicitly gather grains back to their photo positions; reduced motion restores immediately.

materials.name: glass-shell
materials.value: ShaderMaterial; transparent:true; depthWrite:false; FrontSide; base alpha:.012; Fresnel exponent:3.2; curve exponent:1.6; alpha capped at .8
materials.purpose: Thin transparent lathed shell and cloned torus-rim material. Bundled studio-small-09.hdr supplies directional reflection, with stronger edges and a narrow pane highlight; no physical refraction.

materials.name: studio-reflection
materials.value: HDRLoader; direct equirectangular shader sample; PMREM world.environment; environmentIntensity:.5
materials.purpose: Bundled real HDR reflection for the glass; the shader retains its edge tint and pane highlight if the image cannot load.

materials.name: cork
materials.value: CanvasTexture base:#bd9567; MeshStandardMaterial color:0xffffff; bumpScale:.028; roughness:.96; envMapIntensity:.18
materials.purpose: Procedurally textured stopper and small top bevel.

materials.name: pixel-sand-field
materials.value: native Canvas2D:720×432; seeded LCG:907; sample interval:1.9px; jitter:1.7px; 85% 2×2 grains, otherwise 1×1; image-rendering:pixelated; warm luminance palette; background seeded LCG:412
materials.purpose: Loose play only. Hard pixel grains carry photo-derived warm tonal structure, per-grain shade variation and a brighter top-left pixel over seeded brown gaps. The earliest cat demo guides this treatment. No WebGL texture or projected plane renders the loose painting.

materials.name: photo-mantle
materials.value: 1536×~920 color and tangent-normal CanvasTextures; seeded LCG:173; irregular hull sides:5–7; local stretch:.92–1.08 before full-shape rotation:0–2PI; tilted crown and bevel faces; two-pass grain pitches:3.8px fine,7.4px larger; size=pitch*(minimum+pow(rand,.7)*variation), pass minimum/variation:(.38,.24),(.4,.28); crown peak:size*(.32–.44); rim height:size*.035; crown inset:.48–.64; shade:.91–1.13; local-color base:.84; contact-shadow target:.55, coverage:.24, offset:(.28,.4), blur:.35; MeshStandardMaterial color:0xbebebe; normalScale:(.9,.9); roughness:.94; metalness:0; envMapIntensity:.14; map and normalMap wrapS:RepeatWrapping, anisotropy:4; no bumpMap; material dispose owns normalMap.dispose; LatheGeometry radial segments:160; maximum radius:.966; y:-1.535 to 2.10; rotationY:PI
materials.purpose: Opaque packed sand follows the inner glass through shoulder and neck and receives lighting and shadows. Height-based UVs contain the photo once in the straight band from y=-1.49 to 1.20, preserving proportions against the actual circumference and height. Sand-colored support fills the remaining surface. Seam width is applied before the grain color and normal atlases. Compact fully rotated grains, fine underpacking and lower crowns replace the earlier coarse bodies. Each rasterized crown and bevel triangle supplies a sloped tangent-space normal without per-grain mesh geometry or grain collisions.

materials.name: packed-sand-cap
materials.value: 256×256 color and tangent-normal CanvasTextures over #bda17a; seeded LCG:173; irregular hull sides:5–7; local stretch:.92–1.08 before full-shape rotation:0–2PI; tilted crown and bevel faces; two-pass grain pitches:2.2px fine,4.0px larger; size=pitch*(minimum+pow(rand,.7)*variation), pass minimum/variation:(.38,.24),(.4,.28); crown peak:size*(.32–.44); rim height:size*.035; crown inset:.48–.64; shade:.91–1.13; local-color base:.84; contact-shadow target:.55, coverage:.24, offset:(.28,.4), blur:.35; MeshStandardMaterial color:0xbebebe; normalScale:(.9,.9); roughness:.94; metalness:0; envMapIntensity:.14; map and normalMap wrapS:RepeatWrapping, anisotropy:4; no bumpMap; material dispose owns normalMap.dispose; CircleGeometry radius:1; rotationX:-PI/2; scaled by sandRadiusAt(level)
materials.purpose: A sand-colored top cap matches the packed body material, with the same compact fully rotated grain shapes, fine underpacking, lower crowns and per-face tangent normals at smaller texture pitches. It follows the clipping plane during assembly and rests at y=2.10 in the sealed state. The opaque body and cap form the sand volume without a separate dark core. The cap has no per-grain mesh geometry or grain collisions.

materials.name: assembly-grains
materials.value: 2500 ShaderMaterial Points; transparent:false; depthWrite:true; point size clamped:1–4px; top-left highlight:.045
materials.purpose: Temporary flying grains visible from 8% to 97% of assembly progress; hidden in both settled loose and sealed presentations.

provenance.authority: The user-provided cat grain reference and earliest interactive demo guide loose play. Smithsonian and Petra photographs in docs/visual-references.md guide packed material, filled profile and perspective. The world remains code-led: direction seed 889eefe6, grounded candidate 5, personal display plinth. After finer compact grains replaced rice-like coarse shapes, the user accepted the bottle with “瓶子的效果可以了”. The warm sealed material, geometry, camera, glass, lighting and rotation are protected. The user then requested warm-only presentation and a framed flat loose painting. Bottle acceptance does not imply acceptance of the new loose painting.
provenance.tonalRamps: Synthesized OKLCH display metadata with source hue/chroma; these are not additional implemented color tokens.
provenance.notCanonized: The build carries 8–11px ancillary text in several contexts. Those sizes are captured only where needed to reproduce actual snippets, not promoted into a universal legibility rule. No browser or visual verification was performed by this documentation pass.
provenance.currentDemo: src/main.ts uses the bundled src/assets/cat.png illustration; this source image is demonstration content, not a reusable design-system rule.
provenance.reviewEvidence: Fresh actual captures in .impeccable/review/framed-sand include desktop.png, mobile.png, user-590.png, push.png, swirl.png and bottle-desktop.png, bottle-mobile.png, bottle-user-590.png. The capture pass reported no overflow or browser errors at desktop:1440×900, mobile:390×844 and user-590:590×1293. Displayed native canvas sizes were 570×342, 286×171.594 and 486×291.594px respectively. Parent verification matched warm sealed front and turned PNGs exactly against accepted baseline 2cf32f9. This documentation pass did not reopen a browser or establish a new finish-review verdict or user acceptance of the framed painting.

narrative.northStar: A personal display plinth in warm daylight
narrative.overview:
A quiet personal display plinth in warm daylight is the implementation’s working visual metaphor. Warm paper, brown ink and restrained terracotta controls frame the photograph as a small object to keep. The photograph supplies the tonal structure of the warm sand; the surrounding interface stays low in chroma.

This system is extracted from the built application. The user-provided cat grain reference and earliest interactive demo guide loose play. The Smithsonian and Petra photographs recorded in [Visual references](docs/visual-references.md) guide dense packed sand, the filled profile and perspective. Direction seed (889eefe6), grounded candidate 5, remains the code-led personal display plinth. The user accepted the fine-grain bottle with “瓶子的效果可以了”, then requested warm-only presentation and a framed flat loose painting. That acceptance protects the warm sealed material, geometry, camera, glass, lighting and rotation; it does not imply acceptance of the new loose implementation. The name 砂藏 / Sandkeep remains provisional. Reflective glass, textured cork, faceted packed sand and a contact shadow describe the current rendering choices without claiming photorealism.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, low-chroma interface around a photograph rendered as warm sand.
Chinese serif display type paired with Chinese system sans controls.
A large object stage with compact controls and visibly separated states.
Restrained interface depth; soft lift belongs to the picture frame and material depth to the 3D object.

rules.name: The Warm Sand Rule
rules.body: Let the photograph supply the tonal structure of the warm sand. Use clay for the principal action, focus and small identity accents.

rules.name: The Two Type Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the bundled serif for the product name and main headline; use the system sans stack for controls and supporting copy.

rules.name: The Object Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary controls flat; reserve soft elevation for the physical picture frame and material depth for the bottle, cork, grains, plinth and scene contact shadow.

dos: Do use the existing paper, ink, muted, line, clay and stage roles instead of introducing parallel surface colors.
Do preserve the bundled serif headline and system sans control relationship.
Do keep interactive targets at least the observed 44px height or diameter, with the existing clay focus treatment.
Do place the object before creation controls when the studio becomes one column.
Do preserve the finished photograph while turning the bottle and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't extend the picture frame’s soft shadow into ordinary controls or introduce rounded floating panels.
Don't reintroduce an original-color selector or use the photograph’s source colors as competing interface accents.
Don't blur the loose field's hard pixel grains, top-left highlights or dark gaps.
Don't copy the loose field's dark gaps onto packed sand. Keep packed grain variation near its local photo color.
Don't alter the accepted warm sealed renderer to tune loose play; the two presentations have separate rendering and input.
Don't treat bottle acceptance as approval of the new framed painting or claim photorealism from the reference photographs.
